    ("PENDING", "cancel"): "CANCELLED",

ALLOWED = {
    (S.HELD, "pay"): S.PAID,
    (S.HELD, "cancel"): S.CANCELLED,
}

    if nxt is None:

    return nxt, "ok"

    log = []

        else:
